INSERT INTO notification_preferences
             (user_id, kind, in_app, email, quiet_from, quiet_until, timezone)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
           ON CONFLICT (user_id, kind) DO UPDATE SET
             in_app = $3, email = $4, quiet_from = $5, quiet_until = $6,
             timezone = $7
